name: body-flicker-page-jump
intent: Five directional streaks compress the source view in flickerMs 140, then destination identity appears after settleMs 90 — no fade-as-travel.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Destination view shown immediately; streaks suppressed

acceptance: Exactly 5 streaks at angles [-6,-2,0,3,7] fire for flickerMs 140 (scaleX, not opacity fade)
Destination identity appears after settleMs 90; origin view is gone mid-flicker
Replay returns to origin before re-jumping
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows destination immediately with animations disabled
